about: The Kanka import door's tables and wording, read by the Python package (onlyworlds.kanka) and the npm SDK (convertKanka), the same bytes in both. The rules are code in each; this file holds what they read: Kanka's folders to element types, its keys to fields, the fixed key lists, the names the door makes, and every line of its report. A template is Python format syntax: {name}, {name!r} for a quoted name, {n:g} for a number.

why.no_entity: no such entity in the export
why.untyped_type: a module with no OnlyWorlds type keeps its own type
why.entry_differs: the row's entry differs from the entity's (kept as written)
why.members_elsewhere: members on a module that is not organisations
why.parent_missing: its parent is not in the folder
why.posts_meta: a post's layout, place, pins or visibility have no field
why.traits_other: a trait section other than appearance (1) and personality (2)
why.list_more: an item carries more than the id it links
why.locations_one: location links one; every place kept
why.not_integer: the value is not a whole number ({field} is an integer)
why.not_mentions: {field} links a {target}; the value is not a list of mentions
why.mention_not_found: {field} links a {target}; a mention is not one in the folder
why.member_role: a member carries more than the character it links (a role)
why.tag_hidden: the element is hidden and the tag is not; the element keeps x_kanka_entity_tags
why.tag_no_field: Narrative has no field for a {type}; the element keeps x_kanka_entity_tags

notes.root_file: {rel}: a file at the export's root this door does not read
notes.not_entity_file: {rel}: not an entity file (one JSON per entity in a module folder); skipped
notes.no_entity: {rel}: no entity object with an id; skipped
notes.filename_id: {rel}: the filename's number is not the entity's id {entity_id}
notes.second_file: {rel}: a second file for entity {entity_id}; the first is kept
notes.custom_modules: {rel}: custom modules are defined; their entities, if exported, are read by folder
notes.settings_file: {rel}: a settings file this door does not read
notes.mentions_hidden: {element!r}: visible text mentions the hidden {target!r} by name
notes.mirror_missing: relationship {relation!r} on {element!r}: its mirror {mirror} is not in the export; kept one-way
notes.no_text: a relationship from {owner!r} to {target!r} has no text; named {name!r}
notes.no_relation_field: Relation {name!r} from {owner!r}: Relation has no field for a {type}; {end!r} is in x_kanka_source/target only
notes.not_kept: not kept: timestamps and who made or changed a row (created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by), campaign_id and type_id, image focus points and the header image's upload uuid, marketplace ids, pin and display flags, the server's mentions index (the text holds the mentions), and the camelCase twins of a character's lists (characterTraits and the rest: the same rows without their ids)

errors.no_campaign: {source}: no campaign.json with an id (is it Kanka's JSON export?)

report.head: Kanka export {source} ({name!r}): {total} elements ({by_type}).

how.believed: believed, not yet seen in a real export
how.untyped: no OnlyWorlds type: Narratives, supertype {supertype}, subtype {folder!r}

report.starter: Possibly Kanka's starter content (made within {window:g} seconds of the campaign; nothing in the data marks it, so it is imported): {listed}.
report.hidden: Hidden as the source hides it (elements carrying hidden: true): {said}.

posts: post not visible to all, its own Narrative (visibility_id)
posts not visible to all, each its own Narrative (visibility_id)
relationships: relationship hidden on a side or touching a hidden entity (visibility_id)
relationships hidden on a side or touching a hidden entity (visibility_id)

personality: personality trait not visible to players (is_personality_visible)
personality traits not visible to players (is_personality_visible)
attributes: private or hidden attribute (is_private, is_hidden, is_attributes_private)
private or hidden attributes (is_private, is_hidden, is_attributes_private)

report.untagged: Tags not linked to an element that carries them ({n}):
uploads: gallery/: {n} upload read as Kanka's image store; {named} named by an entity.
gallery/: {n} uploads read as Kanka's image store; {named} named by an entity.
report.pictures: Pictures named but not imported ({n}): an OnlyWorlds image_url is a URL, and the folder format has no place for image files yet; each element keeps x_kanka_image:

report.picture_missing: - {element!r}: upload {uuid} is not in gallery/; the uuid kept alone
